Council of Europe Framework Convention on AI
annotation.summary_en: Committee report for first debate on Colombia's Bill 043/2025 Senate - 324/2025 House regulating artificial intelligence. It sets ethical principles, risk categorisation, transparency and accountability, governance institutions, research incentives, AI education and labour transition, and compliance of existing systems. It contains no robot-specific provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Applies to all actors across the AI lifecycle with territorial link or effects in Colombia
Introduces risk categorisation of AI systems and requires existing systems to comply
Provides transparency, accountability and data-handling standards
Promotes AI education in higher education and labour transition measures
Funding via international cooperation and public-private partnerships subject to budget availability
